official_definition: By paying two costs, refresh this Spirit. When you've done so, during this battle, all your Spirits gain +5000 BP, and the opponent can't move any cores, besides 20px, from their Field/Grandwalker Nexuses/Trash.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Grand Twinkle Soar] or [Grand Twinkle Soar: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Grand Twinkle Soar]", "give [Grand Twinkle Soar]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Transitions state from EXHAUSTED to REFRESHED.
